query: UPDATE envelopes SET version = version + 1, status = $4, subject = $5, message = $6, expires_at = $7, reminder_policy = $8, signing_options = $9, seal_profile = $10, sent_at = $11, completed_at = $12, voided_at = $13, void_reason = $14, updated_at = COALESCE($15, updated_at), deleted_at = $16 WHERE account_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $3 RETURNING version
